confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge, not from live booking pages or current listings. Restaurant and beer values are the best grounded. Hostel and hotel rates vary widely by area, room type and season, and July is monsoon low season for leisure demand, so accommodation is less certain. Cocktail and wine values partly rely on the local beer-relative price relationship because direct knowledge is weaker. USD values assume roughly 90 INR per USD and would shift with currency moves. The FX observation comes from search results citing the RBA daily rates page, which was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city; anchored on South Asian metro-level pricing, such as other large Indian cities, adjusted upward for Mumbai's higher hotel and rent levels.
